translation:
Each pill weighs one qian, sealed and wrapped in wax skin, sent down with warm wine, following the location of the disease above or below, taken before or after food. <ins>Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹)</ins> (see the mountain-corner bone injury)
<ins>Gu Chi San (固齒散)</ins> (see the tooth injury)
<ins>Bi Bo San (蓽茇散)</ins> (see the two cheekbone injuries)
<ins>Wan Ling Ointment (萬靈膏)</ins> (see the crown injury)
